absent: Acceptance predicate for a candidate new address owner beyond the invocation point and failure modes of that check.
Complete layouts for address, task, signal, completion, wait request, resource report, and namespace descriptors beyond fields observed in these fragments.
Semantics of probe teardown, register cache deactivation, futex operations, membarrier tracking, lazy translation entry, scheduler cache handling, and out of memory victim resolution.
Behaviour of group time adjustment, identifier lookup and translation, pid table iteration, allocation disabling, and namespace accounting helpers.
Queueing and wakeup guarantees for child exit notification and virtual fork rendezvous beyond single signal assurance.
Full handling of tracing reparenting, job control listening, fatal signal checks, and group stop flags outside observed branches.
Copy and fault behaviour for userspace clearance pointers and detailed wait information beyond observed success and failure paths.

findings.text: Exposes a maintenance operation for the owner association of a shared address descriptor. When invoked by a task that is not the recorded owner it leaves state untouched, and otherwise it guarantees that on return the association is either held by another live participant or explicitly null, never dangling toward a departing task.

Transfer candidacy excludes kernel threads via PF_KTHREAD, favors family membership before system wide consideration, and ends early when sharing collapses. A null outcome despite continued sharing is defined as a transient race with external holders rather than a search failure.

Exposes a release operation used during exit and image replacement. It guarantees idempotent single signalling of any outstanding virtual fork rendezvous via vfork_done with null clearing, discard of probe and cached register context, and userspace clearance notification via clear_child_tid with wakeup via FUTEX_WAKE only while address sharing persists.
Virtual fork rendezvous extraction occurs under task exclusion and leaves the stored pointer null, so repeated or concurrent invocation signals at most once.

Exit time address detachment guarantees single null publication of the current association with barrier ordering and brief interrupt exclusion under mapping and task guards, followed by lazy translation mode with membarrier tracking, then victim handling via TIF_MEMDIE plus owner maintenance plus reference release after guards are released.

Mapping detachment holds mapping read protection and task exclusion across null publication with interrupts masked only around that publication. Owner reassignment scans membership under task list read protection and publishes ownership through single store semantics.

Reaper resolution prefers the configured namespace reaper unless it coincides with the departing father, promotes a same group thread lacking exit marking via PF_EXITING to that role when available, and otherwise reclaims already dead traced entries before terminating the namespace while retaining the father as the fallback reaper.

Serves as the terminal teardown entry for an identifier namespace when its initializer departs. It is responsible for final accounting and reboot code propagation, for blocking further allocations, for forced termination of survivors, for reaping descendants, and for waiting until allocation counts return to initializer baseline.

Shutdown moves through allocation blocking, automatic reaping enablement, forced fatal signalling of members lacking such signals, blocking reap with pending flags via TIF_SIGPENDING with TIF_NOTIFY_SIGNAL cleared before each attempt until no children remain, interruptible sleep until only initializer counts remain, and final code and accounting disposition.

Serves as the in kernel wait request entry. It guarantees that only constrained option combinations are accepted, that the most negative identifier denoted by INT_MIN is rejected as absent, that minus one plus zero plus negative plus positive identifiers select all plus caller group plus named group plus named process respectively, and that status is reported only on successful match with copy failures surfaced distinctly through the common scanning engine.

Exposes a shared scanning engine that translates absence of match into child absence versus retry based on nonblocking choice. Callers are parked on the child exit queue in interruptible state with restart and pending signal handling, while each scan examines direct children per thread together with traced peers unless confined to a single thread.

Eligibility requires identifier match by process, group, or all. Traced or wall scope via __WALL accepts every child, while other scopes partition clone versus non clone children by comparing exit notification against standard child notification via SIGCHLD and clone request via __WCLONE, where clone denotes nonstandard notification or non leader visibility only through tracing.

Per child triage preserves a sticky indicator of future match possibility, ignores entries in EXIT_DEAD, and defers entries in EXIT_TRACE to the tracing path while still marking liveness for natural parents. It suppresses duplicate group stop reporting when tracing intervenes and treats EXIT_ZOMBIE plus stopped plus continued interests with a fixed conceptual precedence.

Zombie disposition from EXIT_ZOMBIE requires exited interest via WEXITED and otherwise takes no action, electing exactly one reaper through an atomic move to EXIT_DEAD for ordinary cases or to EXIT_TRACE for reparented traced leaders, while peek mode via WNOWAIT preserves state with an extra reference. Traced handoff drops guards, detaches from tracing, re notifies the parent, and then either lingers as EXIT_ZOMBIE or reaches final release as EXIT_DEAD.

Reaping a group leader folds its own plus shared plus previously accumulated child measures for time, faults, switches, block activity, peak residency, and accounting into the adopting parent under the parent statistics guard. Resource queries remain available for peeked and non leader observations.

The wait request aggregates matching selectors with flags, optional detailed info and resource pointers, observed status, a sticky absence code, and queue linkage. The resource report aggregates voluntary and involuntary switches with minor and major faults, block counts, peak residency, and user plus system time across the selected scope.

Queries distinguish calling thread via RUSAGE_THREAD, self via RUSAGE_SELF including live threads, already reaped children via RUSAGE_CHILDREN, and combined self with children via RUSAGE_BOTH, stabilizing shared counters under a sequence guard with retry. Peak residency consults live address size when present, residency is expressed in kilobytes, and times use old style interval form.

Stopped code selection uses per task exit code for traced tasks excluding listening state via JOBCTL_LISTENING, and shared group code when group stop via SIGNAL_STOP_STOPPED is flagged. Visibility through tracing needs no extra request while natural parent visibility needs traced option via WUNTRACED and continued visibility needs continued option via WCONTINUED, with observation consuming the stored code or shared marker via SIGNAL_STOP_CONTINUED unless peek via WNOWAIT is requested, distinguishing trapped versus stopped versus continued causes.

Child iteration holds task list read protection, releasing it before potentially faulting resource capture while retaining an extra task reference. Stopped codes, continued markers, and child disposition use signal guards, accumulation and queries use statistics guards, and reaper promotion with dead reclamation uses exclusive task list protection with interrupt masking briefly released during namespace termination.

Owner absence despite sharing indicates racing external holders, zombie reaping across threads requires atomic election with stable state reads, stop and continue markers need revalidation under signal exclusion, and namespace shutdown depends on allocation blocking plus automatic reaping to ensure initializer reap implies global absence.

Status copy and resource capture after dropping task list protection may fault and sleep, requiring a held reference and revalidation of traced state after reacquiring exclusive protection. Child identifier clearance tolerates absent userspace pointers and null virtual fork rendezvous.

Acceptance is limited to hang control via WNOHANG with traced via WUNTRACED with continued via WCONTINUED with single thread via __WNOTHREAD with clone via __WCLONE with wall via __WALL, with any other bit rejected as invalid. The most negative identifier denoted by INT_MIN reports absent, while minus one selects all and zero selects caller group and negative selects named group and positive selects named process.

Zombie status prefers shared group code when group exit via SIGNAL_GROUP_EXIT is flagged, interpreting zero low bits as normal exit and otherwise distinguishing dumped versus killed by high bit and low signal number. Stopped observation encodes shifted code with stopped marker unless peeked, continued without detailed info uses an all ones marker, and detailed causes use CLD_EXITED with CLD_DUMPED with CLD_KILLED with CLD_TRAPPED with CLD_STOPPED with CLD_CONTINUED carrying process plus user plus status fields.

Forced termination uses SIGKILL and automatic reaping uses SIG_IGN applied to SIGCHLD disposition, continued reporting associates with SIGCONT, and clone partitioning compares against SIGCHLD. Absence reports ECHILD with retry via ERESTARTSYS, invalid options via EINVAL, bad identifier via ESRCH, status copy failure via EFAULT, and resource scopes use RUSAGE_THREAD with RUSAGE_SELF with RUSAGE_CHILDREN with RUSAGE_BOTH including page to kilobyte scaling.

Observed task state comprises exit state with exit code, notification signal, tracing linkage, child and sibling linkage, group and leader relations, kernel thread and exiting markers, memory associations, counters, and child wait queue. Observed shared signal state comprises group codes with stop markers, child time and fault aggregates, and a statistics guard, while observed namespace state comprises child reaper with allocation count, identifier table, and reboot request.

Shared services include namespace termination for departing initializers and resource usage query for thread, self, children, or combined scopes. Both are safe from process context with internal handling of references and guards.
